summary:
• Strata — an open‑source package that lets you run the 125‑billion‑parameter Qwen 3.8 Flash Next model locally, providing a private, high‑performance AI assistant without cloud fees.
• Claude Code — Anthropic’s VS Code extension that integrates Claude directly into the editor, now more stable and faster, ensuring reliable code suggestions and secure policy enforcement.
• Whirl — a full‑stack, MIT‑licensed AI chat app built with Next.js and Convex that offers private, extensible conversations with persistent “living documents” and optional services.
• AI System Design — a community‑maintained guide that walks developers through prompt engineering, retrieval‑augmented generation, autonomous agents, and a production checklist for safety and cost.
• GPT‑6 Model Guide — a concise playbook for startups that maps latency, token budget, and reasoning needs to the appropriate OpenAI model, helping control costs.
• Simon Willison’s hard‑budget‑cap recommendation — argues that every pay‑by‑usage service, especially AWS, should enforce a dollar limit that stops workloads, preventing surprise overspend.
